newsitem.title: USA: Resolution to challenge GE CEO pay - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Resolution to challenge GE CEO pay - NYT.

text.p: The Teamsters union has brought a shareholder resolution challenging the compensation of General Electric Co's chairman and chief executive, John Welch, the New York Times said Monday.
The report said the resolution seeks to eliminate a form of deferred compensation for Welch and to place a $1 million limit on the base salaries of GE's five top executives.
It said the resolution would elimate a 1995 arrangement allowing Welch to defer half of his $2 million base pay until retirement in exchange for receiving generous interest payments on the balance.
The proposal will be voted on April 23 at the company's annual meeting, the paper said.
